subject: MAP: MedStream hosting selection & evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>

Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: MAP and suggested eval cadence for hosting decision (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Hi Lisa / Alex,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — attaching the initial MAP (MAP_MedStream_v1.xlsx) and a concise evaluation plan so we can lock the hosting decision and timeline. Key asks up front:
- Please confirm target decision date (we suggested Oct 29).
- Confirm scope for PHI workloads (which services must be isolated / HIPAA-bound).

High-level proposal (summary pulled from the attachment):
1) Week 1 (Oct 20–24): Security evidence exchange (SOC2 snapshot, KMS approach, network diagram).
2) Week 2 (Oct 25–Nov 5): Two-track eval — Hosted (fast path) + Dedicated reserved pool PoC for sustained throughput. If required by audit, run private deployment feasibility in parallel.
3) Decision checkpoint: Oct 29 — pick route (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and sign MAP to commit next-phase procurement/engineering ramp.

Attachments: MAP_MedStream_v1.xlsx (MAP + milestones), SOC2_evidence_stub.pdf (examples), DocuSign_MAP_link.txt (placeholder link).

If that timeline works, we’ll drop in a DocuSign stub for the MAP so procurement can lock dates. I’ve cc’d Marcus and Monica for downstream ETA on technical commitments.

Thanks,

Stephanie Nguyen

Subject: Re: MAP and suggested eval cadence for hosting decision (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Stephanie — thanks, this is helpful. A couple of clarifying items before we commit to dates: 

1) SOC2 evidence: the stub you attached looks fine as a sample. Can you provide a scoped extract showing data retention and audit log retention policies for customer-managed keys? Our security team needs that by Oct 22.
2) Private option: For regulated services we may require on-prem (air-gapped) or VPC-with-HSM. Can you outline high-level network architecture and KMS/HSM integration points? Even a one-page diagram will help.
3) Procurement: we will only sign a MAP that has a clear SLA exception and a pricing guardrail for the Dedicated reserved pool. I’ve cc’d procurement — we’ll coordinate redlines if we proceed.

Alex — can you confirm volumes (RPS and token estimates) for the pilot so they can size Dedicated?

Lisa Chang
Head of IT Security, MedStream Health
lisa.chang@medstream.com

Subject: Internal: MedStream MAP - recommended stance and action items

Stephanie / Monica / Karthik — quick internal read before I respond to Lisa:

Recommendation (short):
- Default: Hosted-first for customer-facing non-PHI flows (fast onboarding, minimal infra).
- Dedicated reserved pool: recommended for sustained PHI traffic — offer as second-phase with pricing guardrail and 30-day ramp.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): position as fallback / compliance-driven option; build feasibility checklist only if MedStream’s security team insists on air-gapped.

Reasoning: Hosted gets them live fastest and preserves their ability to iterate. Dedicated buys isolation and throughput predictability without the full ops cost of private. Private is heavier and should be scoped with Legal/SE for all on-prem requirements.

Action items: 
1) Monica — compile the KMS/HSM integration blurb + network diagram by Oct 21 (to answer Lisa).
2) Karthik — draft Dedicated pricing guardrail + SLA exception language (two options: 3-month pilot vs 12-month commit) by Oct 22.
3) Stephanie — send updated MAP with the two-track eval and DocuSign link once we have Monica/Karthik inputs.

I’ll also prepare a one-page risks table (latency, cost delta, ops overhead) to attach to the MAP.

—Marcus
Director, Solutions Architecture — Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Subject: Re: MAP and suggested eval cadence for hosting decision (Hosted / Dedicated / Private)

Lisa / Alex — thanks for the quick review. Short answers below and an updated MAP attached. I included our DocuSign link so procurement can begin redlines while we finalize technicals.

- SOC2 extract: Monica is pulling a scoped extract showing audit log retention and our KMS flow (will send by Oct 21).
- KMS/HSM + network: see the attached one-pager in the updated MAP (section 'Security & Keys'). Key points: customer keys supported via BYOK with KMS rotation; Dedicated and Private both support HSM-backed keys; VPC peering or private link available for Private option.
- Dedicated pricing guardrail: two commercial options included in the MAP (3-month pilot at pilot-rate, or 12-month commit at committed-rate). Karthik has drafted the guardrail; procurement: you can use the DocuSign draft to propose redlines.

Next steps I’m requesting from MedStream:
1) Confirm decision checkpoint date (we recommend Oct 29) — yes/no by Oct 23.
2) Confirm pilot volumes (Alex) so we can size Dedicated pool.
3) Procurement: start redlines on DocuSign_MAP_link.txt so Legal can review concurrently.
